hints: Because data is recorded to the nearest minute, find true class boundaries: 0.5 to 10.5, 10.5 to 20.5, 20.5 to 25.5, 25.5 to 30.5, 30.5 to 50.5.
Compute frequency densities using FD = frequency / class width: 12/10 = 1.2, 38/10 = 3.8, 68/5 = 13.6, 76/5 = 15.2, 46/20 = 2.3.
Draw bars on a linear time scale from 0.5 to 50.5 with vertical heights equal to the frequency densities, and label axes clearly.
walkthrough:
Find the true class boundaries, class widths, and frequency densities:
$$\begin{aligned} &\text{Interval } 1-10: [0.5, 10.5], \; \text{width } 10, \; \text{FD} = \frac{12}{10} = 1.2 \\ &\text{Interval } 11-20: [10.5, 20.5], \; \text{width } 10, \; \text{FD} = \frac{38}{10} = 3.8 \\ &\text{Interval } 21-25: [20.5, 25.5], \; \text{width } 5, \; \text{FD} = \frac{68}{5} = 13.6 \\ &\text{Interval } 26-30: [25.5, 30.5], \; \text{width } 5, \; \text{FD} = \frac{76}{5} = 15.2 \\ &\text{Interval } 31-50: [30.5, 50.5], \; \text{width } 20, \; \text{FD} = \frac{46}{20} = 2.3 \end{aligned}$$
Plot each bar with corresponding width and height on a grid with linear scales.
Label axes as 'Frequency density' and 'Time in minutes'.
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Calculate true class boundaries:
Data is recorded to the nearest minute, meaning each integer interval $[a, b]$ has true continuous boundaries $[a - 0.5, b + 0.5]$:
- $1-10 \implies [0.5, 10.5]$, width $= 10$
- $11-20 \implies [10.5, 20.5]$, width $= 10$
- $21-25 \implies [20.5, 25.5]$, width $= 5$
- $26-30 \implies [25.5, 30.5]$, width $= 5$
- $31-50 \implies [30.5, 50.5]$, width $= 20$

Step 2: Calculate frequency density for each bar:
$$\text{Frequency density} = \frac{\text{Frequency}}{\text{Class width}}$$
- Bar 1: $\frac{12}{10} = 1.2$
- Bar 2: $\frac{38}{10} = 3.8$
- Bar 3: $\frac{68}{5} = 13.6$
- Bar 4: $\frac{76}{5} = 15.2$
- Bar 5: $\frac{46}{20} = 2.3$

Step 3: Draw the histogram:
- Horizontal axis: Time in minutes, scaled linearly from $0.5$ to $50.5$.
- Vertical axis: Frequency density, scaled linearly starting from $0$ up to at least $16$.
- Draw contiguous bars with the computed boundaries and heights.

hints: Determine the midpoints of the continuous class intervals: 5.5, 15.5, 23, 28, and 40.5.
Divide by total frequency 240: 6210 / 240 = 25.875 minutes (accept 25.88 or 25.9).
walkthrough:
Identify class midpoints for each interval:
$$\text{Midpoints } x: 5.5, \quad 15.5, \quad 23, \quad 28, \quad 40.5$$

Calculate the estimated mean:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum f x}{\sum f} = \frac{6210}{240} = 25.875\text{ minutes (accept 25.88 or 25.9)}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Find the midpoint of each class interval using true boundaries:
- Interval $1-10$ ($[0.5, 10.5]$): midpoint $= \frac{0.5 + 10.5}{2} = 5.5$
- Interval $11-20$ ($[10.5, 20.5]$): midpoint $= \frac{10.5 + 20.5}{2} = 15.5$
- Interval $21-25$ ($[20.5, 25.5]$): midpoint $= \frac{20.5 + 25.5}{2} = 23$
- Interval $26-30$ ($[25.5, 30.5]$): midpoint $= \frac{25.5 + 30.5}{2} = 28$
- Interval $31-50$ ($[30.5, 50.5]$): midpoint $= \frac{30.5 + 50.5}{2} = 40.5$

Step 3: Divide by total frequency $N = 240$:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{6210}{240} = 25.875\text{ minutes}$$
In fractional form: $25\frac{7}{8}$ or $\frac{207}{8}$. Rounded: $25.9$ minutes.
